qualification.details: Research Associate (Ph.D. holders): Awarded or submitted Ph.D. from the Japanese Studies Centre of a reputed institute/university in a regular mode with a minimum of 60% marks at Masters level. Research Associate (Postgraduate holders): Postgraduate from a reputed institute/university in regular mode with a minimum of 60% marks. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience preferably in research, teaching, team coordination, liaison, and digital/social media management.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Lucknow Research Associate Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Lucknow to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate positions at IIM Lucknow is 28th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Research Associate post at IIM Lucknow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications include a Ph.D. in Japanese Studies or a Postgraduate degree with at least 60% marks, along with relevant experience for one of the positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate positions is 40 years, with relaxations applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official website of IIM Lucknow.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
